2607.05353.title: Selective Disclosure Watermarking for Large Language Models
2607.05353.paper_summary: Watermarking methods embed imperceptible and verifiable signals into text generated by large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches include zero-bit schemes for distinguishing synthetic text from human writing and multi-bit schemes for embedding metadata. However, current multi-bit watermarking methods do not allow selective disclosure: verifying any part of the watermark requires revealing the entire embedded message. This lack of control leads to unnecessary information exposure and raises privacy concerns. We propose Hierarchical Vocabulary Routing (HeRo), a watermarking framework that enables selective disclosure of embedded metadata. The method recursively partitions the vocabulary and distributes watermark information across hierarchical layers, so that different verifiers can decode only the portions of the payload corresponding to their access level. We show that the proposed scheme preserves the unbiasedness of the underlying sampling process and thus maintains text quality. Experiments demonstrate that our framework supports fine-grained access control while achieving high detection accuracy and low latency. Code is available at https://github.com/xuyangc03/hero-watermark.
2607.05353.paper_summary_zh: 水印方法將不可察覺且可驗證的信號嵌入大型語言模型（LLMs）生成的文本中。現有的方法包括零位方案，用於區分合成文本和人類寫作，以及多位方案，用於嵌入元數據。然而，目前的多位水印方法不允許選擇性披露：驗證水印的任何部分都需要揭示整個嵌入的消息。這種缺乏控制導致了不必要的信息暴露並引發隱私擔憂。我們提出了分層詞彙路由（HeRo），這是一個水印框架，能夠實現嵌入元數據的選擇性披露。該方法遞歸地劃分詞彙並在分層中分配水印信息，以便不同的驗證者可以僅解碼與其訪問級別相對應的有效載荷部分。我們展示了所提出的方案保留了基礎抽樣過程的無偏性，從而保持文本質量。實驗證明，我們的框架支持細粒度的訪問控制，同時實現高檢測準確性和低延遲。代碼可在 https://github.com/xuyangc03/hero-watermark 獲得。
